metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC on the frozen 22-session label, at least 0.50 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20 and every frozen v1.7 through v2.2 candidate
metadata.formula_policy: qroe(t) = 100 * single-quarter DEDUCT_PARENT_NETPROFIT(t) / TOTAL_PARENT_EQUITY(t-1); pit_droe_1y(t) = qroe(t) - qroe(t-4). Every lag must be an exact adjacent calendar quarter; nearest-quarter substitution and interpolation are forbidden.
metadata.availability_policy: Each current-snapshot component becomes usable only on the first base-provider trading session strictly after max(NOTICE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE). qroe(t) waits for both income(t) and balance(t-1); dROE(t) waits for income(t), balance(t-1), income(t-4), and balance(t-5). No value is backfilled to report end, original notice, or an earlier revision date.
metadata.revision_policy: Eastmoney exposes a current snapshot rather than historical vintages. The final snapshot value is therefore deliberately hidden until its recorded UPDATE_DATE. This can delay or remove historical observations but cannot be relaxed after coverage is seen. Missing or untrustworthy UPDATE_DATE makes the component unavailable.
metadata.staleness_policy: dROE(t) is missing after six calendar months from report end t; an update arriving after that deadline is never used for that quarter.
metadata.missing_policy: Missing or non-finite numerator/denominator, non-positive lagged parent equity, missing exact quarter, invalid date, duplicate conflict, or stale availability fails closed to missing; max(NOTICE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE) is always enforced and no interpolation is allowed.
metadata.holding_policy: Use the paper-supported dRoe1 one-month horizon: a 22-session forward label and a 21-session minimum holding period. Do not alter the formula, direction, validation segment, label, availability rule, or hold threshold after viewing results.
metadata.paper_definition: The paper defines dRoe as current quarterly ROE minus four-quarter-lagged quarterly ROE, using income before extraordinary items divided by one-quarter-lagged book equity; dRoe1 is the one-month holding variant.
metadata.paper_proxy_difference: Eastmoney DEDUCT_PARENT_NETPROFIT and TOTAL_PARENT_EQUITY are public current-snapshot line items. The formula is accounting-line-item aligned, but the conservative UPDATE_DATE delay is not a reconstruction of every historical revision vintage.

f6fa5e54ac1cf233.factor_description: Conservatively delayed point-in-time change in line-item quarterly ROE versus the exact same quarter one year earlier.
f6fa5e54ac1cf233.factor_formulation: score = 100 * deducted parent net profit(t) / parent equity(t-1) - 100 * deducted parent net profit(t-4) / parent equity(t-5); all four components delayed to their latest notice/update boundary; six-month staleness; 22-session label and 21-session holding horizon

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, firms with a larger year-over-year improvement in single-quarter ROE earn higher subsequent one-month returns.
